hypothesis: A 90-day decayed history of transition-normalized race-relative position gain adds running-content information beyond accepted PACE-01 early position.

transformation.eligible_runner: started and numeric hyphen-separated passing order with at least two segments
transformation.structural_exception: one-segment races supply no observation, including Niigata turf straight 1000m

within_race_transform.rank: ascending average tie rank at each checkpoint among eligible runners
within_race_transform.segment_count: number of numeric hyphen-separated positions for the runner
within_race_transform.meaning: positive advanced relative to the field; negative retreated relative to the field

evaluation_policy.candidate_change: add exactly the one registered transition-normalized position-gain column; PACE-02 and PACE-03 remain excluded
evaluation_policy.development_2024: closed until the rolling decision authorizes a milestone
